kindle.probe: user-seeded: pair sap/tap; the device to take liquid from a tree (spile/spout) + its antonym (bung/plug/stopper); aphid as the organism that does the same act

thoughts: The graph HOLDS every piece as a gloss but connects none of them: spile = 'a spout inserted in a maple (or other tree) to draw off sap' AND 'a spigot or plug used to stop the hole in a barrel or cask'; aphid = 'a sap-sucking insect pest'; tap(v) = 'to draw off a liquid from a container or other source'; sap(v) = 'to drain, suck or absorb sap from a tree'.
Vector search cannot retrieve this: cos(spile, aphid)=0.545, cos(tap, aphid)=0.550 - the tool and the insect are far apart; the mechanism lives in the text, not in the vectors.
The device's functional opposite is the sealing device (bung/plug/stopper); and spile itself is BOTH - the same peg stops a cask and draws sap from a tree. One artifact, opposite function.
